alerts.reason: Conagra’s reported net sales rose in fiscal Q3 (A). Grocery & Snacks volume grew 9% excluding divestitures (B), partly because customers replenished inventory (C). As those orders taper and Conagra laps elevated at-home demand, reported net sales could fall at least 5% year on year in fiscal Q4 or Q1.

Activision Blizzard’s consolidated net revenue rose 27% in Q1 (A). Stay-at-home orders gave players more time to play and lifted demand early in the pandemic (C). Q2 and Q3 face that stronger prior-year demand, so a return toward earlier playing habits could push quarterly revenue at least 5% below the prior year.
